description:
Tree location - rear garden  
Access - via garages to rear  

T1 - Approx. H14 S8 60DBH Lime  
Remove regrowth to form bare framework for future management (approx. 2m)  

T2 - Approx. H10 S6 30DBH Sycamore  
Crown reduce height and sides by 1-2m 
Sever Ivy  

T3 - Approx. H8 S4 25DBH Pear   
Remove deadwood  

T4 - Approx. H14 S8 48DBH Ash  
Crown reduce height and sides by 3m  
Sever/shave off excess Ivy  

T5 - Approx. H5 S4 25DBH Malus  
Crown reduce height by 1-2m 
Reduce laterals by 0.5-1m  
Remove deadwood  

T6 - Approx. H14 S8 25DBH Sycamore   
Crown reduce height and sides by 1-2m 
Sever Ivy  

T7 - Approx. H14 S6 28DBH Ash  
Crown reduce height and sides by 1-2m 
Sever Ivy  

T8 - Approx. H3 S2 10DBH self set Elder  
Fell as close as possible to ground level  
Apply appropriate herbicide 

T9 - Approx. H3 S2 10DBH self set Scyamore   
Fell as close as possible to ground level  
Apply appropriate herbicide 

T10 - Approx. H4 S2 15DBH dying Conifer  
Fell as close as possible to ground level 

T11 - Approx. H6 S2 20DBH dying Conifer  
Fell as close as possible to ground level  

T12 - Approx. H3 S3 16DBH Cherry laurel  
Formatively prune  

T13 - Approx. H5 S5 20DBH Cherry laurel  
Formatively prune 

T14 - Approx. H3 S3 15DBH Prunus  
Formatively prune 

GRP1 - various vegetation, bramble/vines, Ivy, shrubs  
Strim all vegetation as close as possible to ground level.  
Remove Ivy on garage wall. 
Shape any remaining shrubs to form neater specimen
